description: Fixed the `Block` class initialization mapping bug where `self.x` and `self.x0` were incorrectly assigned to class dictionary attributes (`self.resid_lambdas`) instead of the forward pass parameters, causing `MuonAdamW` to fail initialization on step 0 and crash the training loop. By correcting this mapping to correctly assign `self.resid_lambdas` (the class attribute) to the forward pass parameters, the optimizer now initializes gradients from the first step, restoring stable val_bpb to ~0.9912.
